items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Fred Day was the leader... I worked with a group on about five pieces.

ctx.x: He had some deal with that electricity where he would amplify the sound of his guitar, and I never have seen it. But you know they would have resonators and different things. Yeah, well he used to play fine guitar, boy.

I used to listen to him all the time. He'd come true nice, just to write a note, you know, pretty nice. But they had all kind of deals, which I don't know much about on guitar. You know, to bring the tone out. I'll tell you something that happened to me in Detroit, after this job that I did, I broke up at the old Wayne Club in Detroit, so I stayed in Detroit that summer, a couple of the guys I met in Detroit talked me into going on a boat, on the great boat up the Mackinac Island, on the Great Lakes cruise boats,…
Well of course you never knew that rock and roll was that? No. Did you ever know Mez Mezroy around here?
